notes.title: Halloween Decoration Hunt
notes.content:
Building Six may be abandoned now, but the employees left behind some festive cheer: tons of Halloween decorations!

This is a free bonus Halloween activity in Hogogeist. Thirty jack-o-lanterns are scattered across the building, one on each level. Rip them down to add them to your collection. But be warned: some of them may be hidden in some pretty sneaky places. Be prepared to search all the dark shadowy corners.

As you gather jack-o-lanterns, you can track your progress from the Settings menu. Collect them all for Steam achievements!

Happy haunting...er, hunting!
